name: easy-onvif-mcp

tools.name: onvif_connect
tools.description: Connect to an ONVIF device and discover its services. Required before any other tool unless ONVIF_HOST / ONVIF_USERNAME / ONVIF_PASSWORD (or ~/.onvif/credentials.json) are set, in which case the first call connects automatically.

host.description: Device host, optionally with a port or scheme, e.g. `192.168.1.10:8080`.

tools.name: onvif_disconnect
tools.description: Close the current device connection.

tools.name: onvif_is_connected
tools.description: Return whether a device connection is currently held.

tools.name: onvif_status
tools.description: Report whether a device is connected and which services were discovered.

tools.name: onvif_probe
tools.description: WS-Discovery multicast probe. Finds ONVIF devices on the local network without needing credentials.

timeout.description: Seconds to listen for probe responses (default 2).

tools.name: onvif_get_device_information
tools.description: Manufacturer, model, firmware, serial number and hardware id of the device.

tools.name: onvif_get_services
tools.description: The services the device implements, with their endpoint URLs.

tools.name: onvif_get_capabilities
tools.description: The full device capability report (all categories).

tools.name: onvif_get_system_date_and_time
tools.description: The device clock, including whether it is NTP or manually set.

tools.name: onvif_get_hostname
tools.description: The device hostname and whether it is DHCP-assigned.

tools.name: onvif_get_dns
tools.description: The device DNS configuration.

tools.name: onvif_get_ntp
tools.description: The device NTP configuration.

tools.name: onvif_get_dynamic_dns
tools.description: The device dynamic DNS settings (type, name, TTL).

tools.name: onvif_get_network_protocols
tools.description: Configured network protocols with ports and enabled flags.

tools.name: onvif_get_users
tools.description: The registered device users and their access levels.

tools.name: onvif_get_relay_outputs
tools.description: The available relay outputs and their settings.

tools.name: onvif_get_storage_configurations
tools.description: The storage configurations (SD cards, mounts) the device reports.

tools.name: onvif_get_discovery_mode
tools.description: The discovery mode of the device (e.g. `Discoverable` / `DiscoverableInUse`).

tools.name: onvif_get_endpoint_reference
tools.description: The device service endpoint reference, used to derive the password equivalent for remote user operation.

tools.name: onvif_get_profiles
tools.description: All media profiles. Every other media and PTZ tool needs a `profile_token` from this list.

reference_token.description: Optional profile token to fetch a single profile.

tools.name: onvif_get_profile
tools.description: A single media profile by token, as reported by the Media1 service of the device. Use onvif_get_profiles on Media2-only devices.

profile_token.description: Media profile token, e.g. `Profile_1`. Obtain it from onvif_get_profiles.

tools.name: onvif_get_stream_uri
tools.description: The RTSP URI for a live stream from the given profile, with credentials embedded where the device allows it.

profile_token.description: Media profile token, e.g. `Profile_1`. Obtain it from onvif_get_profiles.

tools.name: onvif_get_snapshot_uri
tools.description: The URI that returns a JPEG snapshot for the given profile.

profile_token.description: Media profile token, e.g. `Profile_1`. Obtain it from onvif_get_profiles.

tools.name: onvif_get_video_sources
tools.description: The physical video inputs available on the device (Media1 only).

tools.name: onvif_get_audio_sources
tools.description: The physical audio inputs available on the device (Media1 only).

tools.name: onvif_get_media_service_capabilities
tools.description: The capabilities of the device Media service.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_get_status
tools.description: The current PTZ position and movement state.

profile_token.description: Media profile token, e.g. `Profile_1`. Obtain it from onvif_get_profiles.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_get_presets
tools.description: All saved PTZ presets for the profile, with their tokens.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_get_configurations
tools.description: All PTZ configurations defined on the device.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_goto_preset
tools.description: Move the camera to a saved preset.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_set_preset
tools.description: Save the current camera position as a preset. Returns the preset token.

preset_token.description: Existing token to overwrite instead of creating one.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_remove_preset
tools.description: Delete a saved preset.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_absolute_move
tools.description: Move pan/tilt/zoom to an absolute position in the profile's coordinate space (typically -1.0 to 1.0 for pan/tilt).

pan_tilt_x.description: Absolute target position for pan, tilt and zoom. — pan axis.

pan_tilt_y.description: Absolute target position for pan, tilt and zoom. — tilt axis.

zoom.description: Absolute target position for pan, tilt and zoom. — zoom axis.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_relative_move
tools.description: Move pan/tilt/zoom by a relative amount from the current position.

pan_tilt_x.description: Relative translation to apply. — pan axis.

pan_tilt_y.description: Relative translation to apply. — tilt axis.

zoom.description: Relative translation to apply. — zoom axis.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_continuous_move
tools.description: Move at a constant velocity until stopped. Pair with onvif_ptz_stop (or pass a timeout where the device honours one).

tools.name: onvif_ptz_stop
tools.description: Stop ongoing pan/tilt and/or zoom movement.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_move
tools.description: One small step in a direction, with automatic fallback when the device rejects relative moves. Use for "pan left a little" style commands.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_move_up
tools.description: Tilt the camera up by one step.

step.description: Magnitude of the step; omit to use the device default.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_move_down
tools.description: Tilt the camera down by one step.

step.description: Magnitude of the step; omit to use the device default.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_move_left
tools.description: Pan the camera left by one step.

step.description: Magnitude of the step; omit to use the device default.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_move_right
tools.description: Pan the camera right by one step.

step.description: Magnitude of the step; omit to use the device default.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_zoom
tools.description: One zoom step. Positive zooms in, negative zooms out.

tools.name: onvif_ptz_get_service_capabilities
tools.description: The capabilities of the device PTZ service.

tools.name: onvif_imaging_get_status
tools.description: The current imaging settings for a video source.

video_source_token.description: Video source token, from onvif_get_video_sources. The current imaging settings.

tools.name: onvif_imaging_get_presets
tools.description: The imaging presets available for a video source.

video_source_token.description: Video source token, from onvif_get_video_sources. The imaging presets.

tools.name: onvif_imaging_get_current_preset
tools.description: The imaging preset currently applied to a video source.

video_source_token.description: Video source token, from onvif_get_video_sources. The imaging in use.

tools.name: onvif_get_recordings
tools.description: The recordings stored on the device.

tools.name: onvif_get_recording_jobs
tools.description: The recording jobs configured on the device.

tools.name: onvif_get_replay_uri
tools.description: The RTSP URI to replay a stored recording.

tools.name: onvif_get_recording_summary
tools.description: A summary of the recordings available on the device.

tools.name: onvif_find_recordings
tools.description: Starts a recording search and returns the search token. Poll onvif_get_recording_search_results with that token for matches.

keep_alive_time.description: How long the search stays alive, in seconds (e.g. 5).

max_matches.description: Upper bound on matches the device should return.

tools.name: onvif_get_recording_search_results
tools.description: Fetches results for a search token from onvif_find_recordings, waiting up to `wait_time` seconds for more matches to arrive.

wait_time.description: ISO 8601 duration to wait for results, e.g. `PT5S`.

instructions: ONVIF camera and NVR control server. Call onvif_connect once (or set ONVIF_HOST / ONVIF_USERNAME / ONVIF_PASSWORD), then use the onvif_* tools to inspect the device, resolve media URIs, and drive PTZ.
